description: Sends a transaction your wallet signed (base64, every signature in place) to Solana, as the site sends what a wallet signs: { signature }. Only one Souvenir built for you in the last few minutes (build_trade, or prepare_launch's devSwap or souvSwap), signed as it was built; any other is refused (not_built): send it through a Solana RPC. A trade can't be undone once it lands. With no answer from the network in time it may still land: its signature is answered the same. Trading a coin, in order: (1) quote_trade to see what you would get; (2) build_trade with your wallet's address; (3) sign the transaction it answers with your wallet; (4) send_transaction, or send it yourself through any Solana RPC. No sign-in: your wallet's signature is the approval, and Souvenir never needs its private key. The same fees and limits as the coin's page on souvenir.finance. An agent helping a person, which can't sign with their wallet, uses request_trade instead and gives them the link to approve it with their own wallet.

transaction.description: The transaction build_trade answered (or prepare_launch's devSwap or souvSwap), signed by your wallet, base64.

name: send_transaction
title: Send a signed transaction
